# Tark Kinnisvara

> Tark Kinnisvara OÜ (registry code 12950600) is a Tallinn, Estonia company that buys flats needing renovation and inherited flats, renovates them with its own team, and sells the finished homes. Valuation within 24 hours. Site languages: Estonian, Russian, English.

## What we do
- Buy: flats that need renovation and inherited flats in Tallinn and Harju County; free valuation within 24 hours; fast and safe purchase.
- Renovate: design, construction and finishing by our own team.
- Sell: finished, move-in-ready flats, listed on KV.EE with viewing bookings.

- [Home (Estonian)](https://tarkkinnisvara.ee/): company overview, services, FAQ, contact form

- [Map of properties](https://tarkkinnisvara.ee/kaart.html): interactive satellite map of sold, in-renovation and for-sale flats in Tallinn
- [Privacy policy](https://tarkkinnisvara.ee/privacy.html)
